tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Rehearsal Techniques and Strategies

questions.question: Explain how hot-seating and role on the wall help develop character understanding during the devising process.
questions.correctAnswer: Hot-seating reveals what the character knows and feels through questioning; role on the wall shows what is hidden (inside) versus what is visible (outside). Both deepen character understanding — hot-seating is verbal, role on the wall is visual.

questions.question: Describe how you would use thought tracking and conscience alley to explore a character's moral dilemma.
questions.correctAnswer: Thought tracking reveals the character's inner conflict in a specific moment; conscience alley externalises the two sides of the dilemma. Together they show the gap between what a character says and what they think.

questions.question: What is 'marking the moment' and why is it an effective rehearsal technique?
questions.correctAnswer: Marking the moment identifies the most dramatically important point and highlights it — through slow motion, freeze-frame, repetition or sound. It's effective because it directs the audience's attention to the key turning point.
